base_version.description: The version from your last read (an insight's updated_at, a flag's version, or the version a previous call returned). If the object has changed since, nothing is written and you get a conflict.

description.description: New description, written in the same update.

dry_run.description: Apply and validate the change and show the diff, without writing.

json_patch.description: RFC 6902 operations on the insight's `query`, e.g. [{"op":"replace","path":"/source/series/1/event","value":"signup"}] or [{"op":"add","path":"/source/series/-","value":{"kind":"EventsNode","event":"purchase"}}]. Add a `test` op to assert a value first. Use this to change one array element.

op.description: RFC 6902 operation. `test` checks that the value at `path` equals `value` and rejects the whole patch if not.

path.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into the target, e.g. `/source/series/1/event`. `-` appends to an array.

merge_patch.description: RFC 7396 merge patch on `query`, e.g. {"source":{"dateRange":{"date_from":"-30d"}}}. null removes a key. Arrays are replaced whole, so use json_patch for one element.

name.description: New name, written in the same version-checked update.
